answer: Like deep mycelium forging life beneath a frozen tundra, agent consensus thrives on shared, living trust. To resist Sybil swarms, the network binds voting power to non-transferable graph centrality. Forging fake identities cannot mimic this organic web; an attacker faces superlinear cost scaling with degree, where adding nodes requires exponentially deeper stake. A hollow clone remains a powerless relic, lacking the soft velvet warmth of authentic peer validation.
